STT final

Yesterday, Anna and I traveled to Berlin for an interview. At the train station, she said, "Our train is running out of steam." We found a bus, but I said, "Please buy no tickets." Then the company called. The interview was at ten, not nine. We came at nine o'clock forty-five. Please retell this story briefly using both English and German.

Yesterday, Anna and I traveled to Berlin for an interview. On the train station, she said, "Our train is running out of steam." We found a bus, but I said, "Please buy no more tickets." Then the company called. The interview was at ten, not nine. We came at nine fifty. Before entering the office, Anna checked the invitation again. We had brought our documents, but the receptionist asked us to wait downstairs. While we waited, I explained to him again that we had not bought any bus tickets and that the new route had only one correction. The man finally welcomed us and offered us some water. Please retell the complete story briefly using both English and German.
